docs.title: 🔗 LZ Books
docs.text:
Invoice & Order Management for Zoho Books

LZ Books seamlessly integrates your WooCommerce store with Zoho Books, automatically generating invoices, managing payments, and syncing orders with the power of AI.

Key Features: - Automatic invoice generation - Payment synchronization - Sales order management - Inventory tracking - Real-time order updates

📖 View LZ Books Documentation

docs.title: 📦 LZ SKU Sync
docs.text:
Product & Inventory Sync for Zoho Inventory

LZ SKU Sync automates product synchronization between Zoho Inventory and WooCommerce, ensuring your online store always reflects accurate product data and inventory levels.

Key Features: - Real-time product synchronization - Automatic inventory updates - Image management & optimization - Variable product support - Webhook integration - Multi-warehouse support

📖 View LZ SKU Sync Documentation

docs.title: LZ Books - Installation, Activation and Setup
docs.text:
Congratulations on purchasing LZ Books subscription. Now your invoices will have the power of AI and will be generated 100% automatically.

Follow the instructions below to install, activate and set up LZ Books for your ecommerce store.

docs.title: Password Reset
docs.text:
1. Once you purchase, you will be logged in automatically into your dashboard
  2. We recommend that you logout and reset your account password to your choice for easy access
  3. Link to reset password- https://app.linkzoho.com/my-account/lost-password/

docs.title: LZ License key & Domain Mapping
docs.text:
To use LZ Books on your store you will need your exclusive license key and map your domain. Follow the steps below to access

  1. Log into your account
  2. Go to orders
  3. Click the button ‘Add domain’ in front of your successful order. Order status should be ‘processing’ or ‘completed’
  4. You will see your license key, don’t share this key with anyone. You will need this key on the activation stage.
  5. In the domain mapping box, enter the full homepage url of your store. If your store is on a subdomain or a subdirectory then enter the url with full subdomain or subdirectory, look at the image below, don't forget to press save.
  7. After saving it should look like the above image, if you entered a wrong url, press edit and map again.

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text:
Your authentication screen will look like the below image, after successful authentication

  1. Enter the following details before connecting and authenticating
    • Client ID (Refer Zoho API Client Credential Setup)
    • Client Secret (Refer Zoho API Client Credential Setup)
    • Your Zohobooks organization ID
    • In API endpoint enter as per image below
  2. Press connect/authenticate, it will redirect you to a zoho login screen, enter your zoho login credentials
  3. A screen will appear that will ask you to grant privileges to LinkZoho, press ‘Accept/Approve’
  4. You will be redirected back to Wp-admin dashboard and now your ecommerce store is connected to Zoho Books, if any error comes or connection fails, contact LZ support team

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
1. The checks and prerequisites screens looks like below
  2. This screen helps you determine if you have everything in place to connect LinkZoho to your Zoho Books account
  3. You need 3 things
    • An active ZohoBooks or ZohoOne subscription
    • A Zoho Client having ZohoBooks API credentials (read Zoho API Client Credential point)
    • And your ZohoBooks Organization ID

docs.title: Client Credentials
docs.text:
1. Visit the Zoho developer console platform- https://accounts.zoho.com/developerconsole
  2. Login using your Zoho credentials
  3. Once logged in Press the button ‘+Add Client’ on the top right corner, as shown in the image below
  4. Choose client type as ‘Server based applications’, as shown in the image below
  5. Enter New client details as follows, refer the image below
    • Client name of your choice
    • Client type- server based
    • Your store homepage url in Homepage URL
    • In authorized redirect uris, enter the homepage url followed by ‘/wp-admin’ refer the image below
    • Press create to create a Zoho API client
  6. Access client Id and client secret , refer the image below
  7. You have successfully created a new Zoho API client, don't change anything under settings

docs.title: Access the Inventory Setup
docs.text: Go to WP Admin Menu> LinkZoho > Settings > Inventory Tab

docs.title: Configure Warehouse Mapping
docs.text:
1. Under Branch/Location/Warehouses, select the Branch/Locations/Warehouses you want to map for Woocommerce orders

    • Example: Head Office (Location), Main Warehouse (Warehouse linked to location)

  2. Inventory levels of Items listed in mapped locations will be automatically deducted based on relevant Woocommerce orders

docs.title: Option A: Strict SKU Matching (Recommended)
docs.text:
Ideal for businesses requiring precise inventory tracking.

  • Check Set SKU as Primary ID for Inventory Deductions.

    • Behavior:

      • SO and Invoices only generate if all SKUs in the WooCommerce order exist in Zoho Items.
      • If any SKU is missing or not found in Zoho items or Woocommerce, the order is skipped, and an order note is added to the specific Woo order (e.g., "SKU Not Found – SO and Invoice Not Created").

    • Use Case: Ensures 100% inventory accuracy but requires rigorous SKU alignment.

docs.title: Option B: Flexible Matching (SKU or Product Name)
docs.text:
Ideal for businesses with inconsistent SKU systems.

  • Uncheck Set SKU as Primary ID for Inventory Deductions.

    • Behavior:

      • Uses Product Name or SKU for inventory deductions.
      • SO and Invoices generate even if SKUs/names are missing in Zoho Items or woocommerce

    • Use Case: Useful for testing or transitional phases but risks inventory inaccuracies.

docs.title: Handling SKU Mismatches
docs.text:
• If SKU Not Found (Strict Mode):
    • The plugin skips SO/Invoice creation in Zoho Books
    • Adds an order note in WooCommerce (e.g., "LinkZoho: SKU Not Found – SO and Invoice Not Created").

docs.title: Access the Invoice Template Setup
docs.text: Go to WP Admin Menu> LinkZoho > Settings > Invoice Tab

docs.title: Choose Order Status
docs.text:
Select when invoices should be generated

  1. Processing: Generate zoho invoices when orders are marked as "Processing."
  2. Completed: Generate zoho invoices only after orders are marked as "Completed."

docs.title: Option A: Use a Single Template for All Countries
docs.text:
Ideal for businesses with uniform invoicing rules.

  1. Select Same Invoice Template for all countries.
  2. Under Select Invoice Template, choose a template (e.g., "Invoice Template").
  3. Click Save Changes.

docs.title: Option B: Use Country-Specific Templates
docs.text:
Ideal for region-specific tax, language, or compliance requirements.

  1. Select Specific Invoice template for specific countries.

  2. Assign templates to country groups:

    a. Under Select Invoice Template, choose a template (e.g., "USA Invoice Template").

    b. Click Select Countries and choose valid countries (e.g., United States).

    c. Click Insert Row to add another template-country group (e.g., assign "ROW" to Albania, Belize, etc.).

    d. Repeat until all countries are mapped.

    e. Use Delete to remove incorrect entries.

  3. Click Save Changes.

docs.title: Enable Invoice Emailing (Optional)
docs.text:
1. Check Enable Invoice Emailing to automatically email invoices to customers.
  2. Select an Email Template (preconfigured in Zoho Books) for consistency

docs.title: Access the Payment Setup
docs.text: Go to WP Admin Menu> LinkZoho > Settings > Payments Tab

docs.title: Option A: Use the Same Banking Account for All Branches
docs.text:
Ideal for businesses with centralized financial operations.

  1. For each payment method (e.g., "Direct Bank Transfer," "Stripe"): a. Same Zoho Banking for all branches. b. Under Choose Zoho Banking, select the corresponding account (e.g., "Stripe Clearing" for Stripe payments).
  2. Click Save Changes.

docs.title: Option B: Assign Banking Accounts to Specific Branches
docs.text:
Ideal for multi-branch businesses needing localized financial tracking.

  1. For each payment method (e.g., "Check Payments"):

    a. "Same Zoho Banking for all branches."

    b. Under Branch / Business Locations, select the applicable branches (e.g., "Head Office," "SouthWest Branch, etc.").

    c. Under Zoho Banking, choose the banking account linked to those branches.

  2. Repeat for all payment methods.

  3. Click Save Changes.

docs.title: Activation
docs.text:
1. Activation screen looks like the below image
  2. Enter your order number, you will find this in your dashboard
  3. Your license key
  4. The requesting domain should be similar to the domain mapped in your LinkZoho dashboard
  5. Press activate, if all entries are correct, your plugin will get activated and you will see your plugin expiry date
  6. Click on Proceed

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
1. Install the shared/downloaded zip file of plugin in your ecommerce store
  2. After installation activate the plugin in your plugin list
  3. You should now see a LinkZoho option in your admin dashboard menu

docs.title: Accessing Sales Orders Settings
docs.text:
1. Go to WP Admin Menu> LinkZoho > Settings > Sales Order Tab
  2. Enable Sales Orders Generation (checkbox)

docs.title: Choose a Template Configuration
docs.text: You have two options:

docs.title: Option A: Use a Single Template for All Countries
docs.text:
Ideal for businesses with uniform invoicing rules across regions.

  1. Select Same Sales Order Template for all countries.
  2. Under Select Sales Order Template, choose Standard Template (or a custom template preconfigured in Zoho Books).
  3. Click Save Changes.

docs.title: Option B: Use Country-Specific Templates
docs.text:
Ideal for businesses needing region-specific tax, language, or formatting rules.

  1. Select Specific Sales Order template for specific countries.

  2. Assign templates to country groups:

    a. Under Select Sales Order Template, choose a template (e.g., "Standard Template").

    b. Click Select Countries and choose applicable countries (e.g., Australia, Canada etc.).

    c. Click Insert Row to add another template-country group (e.g., assign a "EU Template" to Greece).

    d. You can use ‘Select all’ and ‘Select none’ buttons to select or de-select all countries in one go.

  3. Repeat until all country groups are mapped.

  4. Click Save Changes.

docs.title: LZ SKU Sync - Overview
docs.text: Automate Product Synchronization Between Zoho Inventory and WooCommerce

docs.title: What is LZ SKU Sync?
docs.text: LZ SKU Sync is a premium WordPress plugin that automatically synchronizes products, inventory levels, images, and attributes between Zoho Inventory and WooCommerce. Keep your online store always up-to-date with accurate information from Zoho.

docs.title: 🚀 Save Time
docs.text: Stop manually updating product information in WooCommerce. LZ SKU Sync automates the entire process.

docs.title: ✅ Prevent Errors
docs.text: Eliminate data entry mistakes with automated synchronization using Zoho Inventory as the source of truth.

docs.title: 📊 Real-Time Updates
docs.text: With webhook integration, changes in Zoho Inventory appear in your WooCommerce store within seconds.

docs.title: 🖼️ Automatic Image Management
docs.text: Product images are downloaded and organized automatically.

docs.title: 📦 Multi-Warehouse Support
docs.text: Sync inventory from specific warehouses in your Zoho account.

docs.title: Synchronization Modes
docs.text:
• Manual Sync: One-click bulk synchronization
  • Real-Time Webhook Sync: Automatic synchronization when products change in Zoho

docs.title: Complete Product Support
docs.text:
• ✅ Simple products
  • ✅ Variable products with attributes and variations
  • ✅ Product images (featured and gallery)
  • ✅ SKU-based matching

docs.title: Product Data
docs.text:
• Product name and description
  • SKU and pricing
  • Stock quantities and status
  • Weight and dimensions
  • Product images

docs.title: Inventory Management
docs.text:
• Multi-warehouse support
  • Real-time stock updates
  • Low stock notifications
  • Inventory overview dashboard

docs.title: Granular Control
docs.text:
• Choose to create new products or only update existing
  • Control product status (Draft, Pending, Published)
  • Separate controls for simple products and variations

docs.title: WordPress Environment
docs.text:
• WordPress 4.7 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher (8.0+ recommended)
  • WooCommerce 7.9 or higher

docs.title: Zoho Requirements
docs.text:
• Active Zoho Inventory account
  • API access enabled (included in all plans)

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
1. Install & Activate - Upload the plugin and activate your license
  2. Initial Setup - Connect to Zoho Inventory
  3. Choose Sync Method - Select manual or webhook sync
  4. Configure Settings - Customize what data to sync

docs.title: Image Management
docs.text: Configure how product images are synchronized from Zoho Inventory to WooCommerce.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
LZ SKU Sync automatically handles product images:

  • ✅ Downloads images from Zoho Inventory
  • ✅ Uploads to WordPress Media Library
  • ✅ Generates standard WordPress thumbnails
  • ✅ Prevents duplicate images
  • ✅ Assigns images to products and variations
  • ✅ Manages gallery images for variable products

Note

Image processing happens in the background to prevent timeouts. You can close your browser - images will continue downloading.

docs.title: Image Sync Settings
docs.text: Control which images are synchronized:

docs.title: Product Image (Featured)
docs.text:
• Main product image shown on product listings
  • First image from Zoho becomes featured image
  • Enable/disable in Sync Status > Sync Preferences

docs.title: Gallery Images
docs.text:
• Additional product images
  • Displayed in product image carousel
  • Enable/disable in Sync Status > Sync Preferences

Note

Both options can be enabled/disabled independently in Product Settings.

docs.title: Variable Product Images
docs.text:
For variable products (product groups in Zoho):

  • Each variation gets its own images
  • Parent product automatically inherits variation images
  • Duplicates are automatically filtered out

docs.title: Zoho Inventory
docs.text:
• Images must be attached to items in Zoho Inventory
  • Supported formats: JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP
  • Maximum recommended size: 5MB per image
  • Multiple images per product supported

docs.title: WordPress
docs.text:
• GD or Imagick PHP extension recommended
  • Uploads directory must be writable
  • Sufficient disk space for images

docs.title: Before Syncing
docs.text:
1. ✅ Upload high-quality images to Zoho Inventory
  2. ✅ Use descriptive image filenames
  3. ✅ Remove unnecessary images from Zoho to speed up sync

docs.title: After Sync
docs.text:
1. ✅ Review products to ensure images are correct
  2. ✅ Delete unused media via Media > Library (if needed)
  3. ✅ Use image optimization plugins for WebP/compression (optional)

docs.title: Images Not Appearing
docs.text:
Solutions:

  • ✅ Verify images exist in Zoho Inventory (Items → Attachments)
  • ✅ Check "Product Image" is enabled in sync preferences
  • ✅ Check Sync Log for errors
  • ✅ Contact your hosting provider about upload permissions

docs.title: Images Taking Long to Sync
docs.text: This is normal - images are rate-limited to comply with Zoho API limits. For large catalogs, image sync may take 10-20 minutes. Images continue downloading even if you close your browser.

docs.title: Low Quality Images
docs.text: Upload higher resolution images to Zoho Inventory. The plugin downloads images at their original quality.

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text:
• Configure Inventory Settings → - Manage warehouse and stock
  • Monitor Sync Progress → - Track image downloads
  • Troubleshooting Guide → - Solve image issues

docs.title: Support
docs.text:
Questions about image management?

  • 📧 Email: sales@linkzoho.com, support@krenovate.com

docs.title: Initial Setup & Configuration
docs.text: After installing and activating LZ SKU Sync, follow these steps to connect your WordPress site to Zoho Inventory.

docs.title: Authentication with Zoho Inventory
docs.text: LZ SKU Sync uses OAuth 2.0 to securely connect with your Zoho Inventory account through the LinkZoho OAuth Bridge.

docs.title: Step 1: Navigate to Authentication Settings
docs.text:
1. In WordPress admin, go to LZ SKU Sync > Settings
  2. Click the Authentication tab
  3. You'll see the connection interface

docs.title: Step 2: Select Your Datacenter
docs.text:
1. Click the Authentication Tab button
  2. Select your Zoho Datacenter from the dropdown (e.g., .com, .in, .eu, .com.au, .jp)
  3. Click Authenticate

Note

What is a Datacenter? Zoho operates servers in multiple regions. Select the datacenter where your Zoho account is registered (usually matches your country/region).

docs.title: Step 3: Login to Zoho (If Needed)
docs.text:
1. You'll be redirected to Zoho Accounts login page
  2. If you're already logged in to Zoho, this step will be skipped automatically
  3. If not logged in, enter your Zoho credentials and click Sign In

docs.title: Step 4: Authorize LZ SKU Sync
docs.text:
After logging in, you'll see the Zoho OAuth consent screen:

  1. Review the permissions being requested
  2. Check the checkbox: "I allow LZ Server Based OAuth to access the above data from my Zoho account..."
  3. Click Accept to grant permissions

docs.title: Required Permissions
docs.text:
LZ SKU Sync requests the following Zoho Inventory permissions:

  • ✅ To manage all of your Zoho Inventory data

Important

Without the permission, the plugin cannot sync your products.

docs.title: Step 5: Redirect to WordPress
docs.text:
After clicking Accept:

  1. You'll be automatically redirected back to your WordPress site
  2. The plugin will complete the authentication process
  3. You'll land on the LZ SKU Sync Authentication page

docs.title: Step 6: Select Organization
docs.text: If your Zoho account has multiple organizations, you'll need to select which one to sync from.

docs.title: Single Organization Users
docs.text: • If you have only one organization, it will be automatically selected

docs.title: Multiple Organization Users
docs.text:
1. After authorization, you'll see a dropdown with all your organizations
  2. Select the organization you want to sync products from
  3. Click Save Organization

Tip

Using Multiple Organizations? You can only sync from one organization at a time. To switch organizations later, disconnect and reconnect with a different organization selected.

docs.title: Step 7: Verify Connection
docs.text:
After successful connection, you'll be redirected back to WordPress. You should see:

✅ Authentication Status: Connected ✅ Organization Name: Your selected organization ✅ API Domain: Your Zoho datacenter (e.g., .com, .in, .eu, .com.au, .jp) ✅ Token Expiry: Next refresh time

docs.title: Connection Details
docs.text:
After connecting, the plugin stores your connection securely:

  • Your selected organization
  • Connection to your Zoho datacenter

Note

Security: Connection details are encrypted and stored securely.

docs.title: Step 8: Select Warehouse
docs.text:
After authentication, configure which warehouse to sync inventory from.

  1. Go to LZ SKU Sync > Sync Status tab
  2. Find Sync Preferences section
  3. Look for Select Warehouse / Location to sync dropdown
  4. Select your warehouse/location from the list

Important

Multi-Warehouse Support LZ SKU Sync can sync from any warehouse in your Zoho Inventory, but only one warehouse at a time. Stock quantities and availability will reflect the selected warehouse.

docs.title: Understanding API Datacenters
docs.text:
Zoho operates servers in multiple regions. LZ SKU Sync automatically detects your datacenter:

Datacenter API Domain Regions US inventoryapi.zoho.com United States India inventoryapi.zoho.in India Europe inventoryapi.zoho.eu Europe Australia inventoryapi.zoho.com.au Australia Japan inventoryapi.zoho.jp Japan Canada inventoryapi.zoho.ca Canada China inventoryapi.zoho.com.cn China Saudi Arabia inventoryapi.zoho.sa Saudi Arabia

Note

The correct datacenter is automatically configured during authentication. You don't need to change this manually.

docs.title: Disconnecting from Zoho
docs.text:
To disconnect and reconnect with a different organization:

  1. Go to LZ SKU Sync > Settings > Authentication
  2. Click Disconnect button
  3. Confirm the disconnection
  4. Follow Steps 2-8 again to reconnect

Warning

Disconnecting Will:

  • Delete stored access tokens
  • Stop webhook synchronization
  • Require re-authentication to sync again

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text:
✅ Connected to Zoho Inventory ✅ Organization selected ✅ Warehouse configured

You're ready to start syncing!

Choose Your Sync Method →

docs.title: Connection Failed
docs.text:
Problem: "Failed to connect to Zoho" error

Solution:

  • Check your internet connection
  • Verify Zoho Inventory is accessible
  • Try disconnecting and reconnecting
  • Clear browser cache and try again

docs.title: Organization Not Appearing
docs.text:
Problem: Your organization doesn't show in the dropdown

Solution:

  • Verify you have admin access to the organization in Zoho
  • Check that the organization has Zoho Inventory enabled
  • Try logging out of Zoho and reconnecting

docs.title: Token Refresh Failures
docs.text:
Problem: "Token expired" or "Authentication failed" errors

Solution:

  • The plugin auto-refreshes tokens every 58 minutes
  • If refresh fails, disconnect and reconnect
  • Check that your Zoho account hasn't been suspended
  • Verify API access is enabled in Zoho settings

docs.title: Wrong Datacenter Detected
docs.text:
Problem: API calls failing due to incorrect datacenter

Solution:

  • The datacenter is detected from your Zoho account region
  • Disconnect and reconnect to refresh datacenter detection
  • Contact support if issue persists

docs.title: Support
docs.text:
Having trouble with authentication?

  • 📧 Email: sales@linkzoho.com, support@krenovate.com
  • Include error messages and screenshots if possible

docs.title: Installation & Activation
docs.text: This guide will walk you through installing and activating the LZ SKU Sync plugin on your WordPress site.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
Before installing LZ SKU Sync, ensure you have:

✅ WooCommerce Installed - LZ SKU Sync requires WooCommerce to function ✅ WordPress Admin Access - You'll need administrator privileges ✅ Plugin ZIP File - Downloaded from your purchase ✅ License Key - Received via email after purchase

docs.title: Step 1: Install WooCommerce
docs.text:
LZ SKU Sync requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

If WooCommerce is not already installed:

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in WordPress admin
  2. Search for "WooCommerce"
  3. Click Install Now
  4. Click Activate
  5. Complete the WooCommerce setup wizard (optional - you can skip this)

Note

LZ SKU Sync will not activate if WooCommerce is not active on your site.

docs.title: Step 2: Upload LZ SKU Sync Plugin
docs.text:
1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Click Upload Plugin button at the top
  4. Click Choose File
  5. Select the LZ-SKU-Sync.zip file you downloaded
  6. Click Install Now
  7. Wait for the upload to complete

docs.title: Step 3: Activate the Plugin
docs.text:
1. After installation completes, click Activate Plugin
  2. You'll be automatically redirected to the LZ SKU Sync settings page
  3. You should see a new "LZ SKU Sync" menu item in your WordPress admin sidebar

docs.title: Step 4: Activate Your License
docs.text: License activation is required to use the plugin and receive updates.

docs.title: Get Your License Information
docs.text:
Before activating:

  1. Log into your account at app.linkzoho.com
  2. Go to Orders
  3. Find your LZ SKU Sync order
  4. Click View License or similar button
  5. Copy your Order ID and License Key

Important

Keep your license key confidential. It's used for authentication and webhook security.

docs.title: Activate the License
docs.text:
1. You'll see the License Activation screen after plugin activation
  2. Enter your Order ID
  3. Enter your License Key
  4. Click Activate License

docs.title: What Happens During Activation
docs.text:
The plugin connects to LinkZoho's servers to:

  • ✅ Validate your purchase
  • ✅ Enable automatic updates
  • ✅ Activate plugin features
  • ✅ Enable webhook functionality

docs.title: Activation Success
docs.text:
After successful activation, you'll see:

  • ✅ Green success message
  • 🔐 License status showing as "Active"
  • 📅 License expiry date (if applicable)

docs.title: Step 5: Prerequisites Check
docs.text:
After license activation, the plugin will guide you through the prerequisites screen.

This screen helps you determine if you have everything in place to connect LZ SKU Sync to your Zoho Inventory account.

You need 3 things:

  • An active Zoho Inventory or Zoho One subscription
  • A Zoho Client with Zoho Inventory API credentials (read Initial Setup for details)
  • Your Zoho Inventory Organization ID and Warehouse selection

docs.title: Step 6: Verify Installation
docs.text:
To confirm everything is working:

  1. Check for the LZ SKU Sync menu in WordPress admin sidebar
  2. Click LZ SKU Sync > Settings
  3. You should see the settings page with multiple tabs:
    • Authentication
    • Sync Status
    • Product Settings
    • Inventory Overview

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text:
✅ Plugin installed and activated ✅ License activated ✅ System requirements verified

You're ready to connect to Zoho Inventory!

Continue to Initial Setup →

docs.title: Plugin Won't Activate
docs.text:
Problem: "The plugin does not have a valid header" or similar error

Solution:

  • Ensure you uploaded the correct ZIP file
  • Don't unzip the file before uploading
  • Download a fresh copy if needed

docs.title: License Activation Fails
docs.text:
Problem: "Invalid license key" or "Order ID not found"

Solution:

  • Double-check your Order ID and License Key
  • Ensure order status is "Processing" or "Completed"
  • Check that you haven't exceeded site activations
  • Contact support if problem persists

docs.title: WooCommerce Not Detected
docs.text:
Problem: "WooCommerce is required" error

Solution:

  • Activate WooCommerce before activating LZ SKU Sync
  • Ensure WooCommerce is up to date (7.9+)
  • Check that WooCommerce isn't deactivated by another plugin

docs.title: Support
docs.text:
Need assistance with installation?

  • 📧 Email: sales@linkzoho.com, support@krenovate.com
  • Include your WordPress version, PHP version, and error messages

docs.title: Inventory Management
docs.text: Monitor and manage your product inventory with the comprehensive Inventory Overview dashboard.

docs.title: Accessing Inventory Overview
docs.text:
1. Go to LZ SKU Sync > Inventory Overview
  2. View real-time statistics about your products
  3. Compare Zoho and WooCommerce inventories
  4. Identify missing or mismatched SKUs

docs.title: Statistics Display
docs.text: The Inventory Overview provides comprehensive statistics about your products across both systems.

docs.title: WooCommerce Products
docs.text:
Total Products

  • Count of all products in WooCommerce
  • Includes simple and variable products

Simple Products

  • Total simple products
  • How many have SKUs assigned
  • How many are missing SKUs

Variable Products

  • Count of parent variable products
  • Total number of variations
  • Variations with/without SKUs

docs.title: Zoho Inventory Items
docs.text:
Total Items

  • All items in selected warehouse
  • Includes simple items and product groups

Ungrouped Items (Simple Products)

  • Standalone items in Zoho
  • Not part of any product group

Grouped Items (Variations)

  • Items that are part of product groups
  • Represent product variations

docs.title: Stock Information
docs.text:
For each category, view:

  • Available Stock: Stock available for sale
  • Actual Stock: Total physical stock
  • Difference helps identify reserved/allocated stock

Column Description SKU Product SKU Zoho Name Product name in Zoho Inventory WooCommerce Name Product name in WooCommerce Sync Status Last sync timestamp Action Quick sync button

docs.text:
SKUs that exist in Zoho but not in WooCommerce:

docs.title: Missing in Zoho
docs.text:
WooCommerce SKUs that don't exist in the selected Zoho warehouse:

Column Description SKU Product SKU from WooCommerce Name Product name from WooCommerce Note Potential reason

docs.title: Multi-Warehouse Support
docs.text: LZ SKU Sync supports syncing from any warehouse in your Zoho Inventory account. You can only sync from one warehouse at a time.

docs.title: Selecting a Warehouse
docs.text:
1. Go to LZ SKU Sync > Sync Status
  2. Find Sync Warehouse dropdown in Sync Preferences
  3. Select the desired warehouse
  4. Click Save Preferences
  5. Run a new sync to update stock from the new warehouse

Important

Changing warehouses affects which stock quantities are synced to WooCommerce.

docs.title: Refresh Inventory Data
docs.text: The Inventory Overview fetches data from both systems:

docs.title: Understanding Sync Actions
docs.text: The Inventory Overview annotates each product with its predicted sync action:

docs.title: Will Create
docs.text:
• SKU doesn't exist in WooCommerce
  • "Create Missing Products" is enabled
  • Product type matches enabled settings

docs.title: Will Update
docs.text:
• SKU exists in both systems
  • Product data will be refreshed from Zoho
  • Based on enabled field sync settings

docs.title: Will Ignore
docs.text:
• SKU doesn't exist in WooCommerce
  • "Create Missing Products" is disabled
  • Or product type creation is disabled

docs.title: Using Inventory Data for Decision Making
Before Initial Sync

Review the comparison tables to:

docs.title: Products Not Appearing in Zoho List

Problem: Expected products missing from Zoho inventory

docs.title: Product Sync Settings
docs.text: Configure exactly what product data gets synchronized from Zoho Inventory to WooCommerce.

docs.title: Accessing Sync Preferences
docs.text:
1. Go to LZ SKU Sync > Sync Status
  2. Find the Sync Preferences Tab
  3. Configure the settings described below
  4. Click Save Preferences after making changes

docs.title: Sync Warehouse
docs.text:
Choose which Zoho Inventory warehouse to sync products from.

Settings:

  • Dropdown lists all warehouses/locations in your organization
  • Only items from the selected warehouse will be synced
  • Stock quantities reflect the selected warehouse's inventory

Important

Multi-Warehouse Limitation: You can only sync from one warehouse at a time. To switch warehouses, change the selection and run a new sync.

docs.title: Sync Frequency
docs.text: Control when synchronization occurs.

docs.title: Options
docs.text:
One-Time (Manual)

  • Sync only when you click "Start Sync" button
  • Full control over timing
  • Best for testing or occasional updates

Always (Real-time webhook)

  • Automatic sync when items change in Zoho
  • Real-time updates within seconds
  • Best for ongoing operations

Tip

See Sync Methods for detailed comparison of these options.

docs.title: Product Creation Options
docs.text: Control whether new products are created or only existing products are updated.

docs.title: Create Missing Products (Simple)
docs.text:
When enabled ✅:

  • Creates new simple products in WooCommerce if SKU doesn't exist
  • Useful for adding new inventory to your store

When disabled ❌:

  • Only updates existing simple products
  • Ignores new SKUs from Zoho
  • Useful when you want to prevent automatic product creation

docs.title: Create Missing Variations
docs.text:
When enabled ✅:

  • Creates new variable products and variations if SKU doesn't exist
  • Automatically generates WooCommerce attributes from Zoho variation data
  • Useful for adding new product variants

When disabled ❌:

  • Only updates existing variations
  • Ignores new variation SKUs from Zoho
  • Useful when you manage product structure manually in WooCommerce

Note

Existing Products: Whether enabled or disabled, existing products matching the SKU will always be updated according to your field sync settings.

docs.title: Product Status
docs.text: Choose the WordPress post status for newly created products.

docs.title: Available Options
docs.text:
Draft 📝

  • Products saved but not visible on your store
  • Allows manual review before publishing
  • Best for quality control workflows

Pending Review 👀

  • Products awaiting manual approval
  • Visible to administrators only
  • Best for multi-user approval processes

Published ✅ (Recommended)

  • Products immediately visible on your storefront
  • Skip manual review step
  • Best for fully automated workflows

Tip

Recommended: Use "Published" if you trust your Zoho Inventory data. Use "Draft" if you want to review products before making them live.

docs.title: Field Sync Settings
docs.text: Enable or disable synchronization of specific product fields.

docs.title: Simple Product Fields
docs.text:
Control which fields are synced for simple products:

Field Description Recommendation Sales Price Regular price from Zoho ✅ Always enable Stock Quantity Available stock from selected warehouse ✅ Always enable Low Stock Reorder level threshold ✅ Enable for inventory alerts Description Product long description ✅ Enable for SEO Weight Product weight (with unit conversion) ⚠️ Enable if you ship by weight Dimensions Length, Width, Height ⚠️ Enable if needed for shipping Product Image Featured image ✅ Enable for visual appeal Gallery Images Additional product images ✅ Enable for better product display

docs.title: Variable Product Fields
docs.text:
The same field options apply to variations, plus:

  • Each variation gets its own SKU, price, stock, and images
  • Parent product automatically inherits first variation's images
  • Attributes are automatically created from Zoho variation data

docs.title: Unit Conversions
docs.text:
The plugin automatically converts units from Zoho to WooCommerce:

Weight

  • Supports: kg, g, lb, oz
  • Converts to your WooCommerce weight unit

Dimensions

  • Supports: cm, m, in, ft
  • Converts to your WooCommerce dimension unit

Note

Conversion is automatic. No manual configuration needed!

docs.title: Initial Setup (First Sync)
docs.text:
✅ Create Missing Products (Simple): Enabled
✅ Create Missing Variations: Enabled
✅ Product Status: Draft (for review)
✅ All Fields: Enabled

Why? Import everything first, review products, then publish.

docs.title: Ongoing Operations (Webhook Sync)
docs.text:
✅ Sync Frequency: Always (Real-time webhook)
✅ Create Missing Products: Enabled
✅ Create Missing Variations: Enabled
✅ Product Status: Published
✅ All Fields: Enabled

Why? Fully automated real-time sync.

docs.title: Update Only (No New Products)
docs.text:
❌ Create Missing Products: Disabled
❌ Create Missing Variations: Disabled
✅ Product Status: Published
✅ Selected Fields: As needed

Why? Only update existing products, don't create new ones.

docs.title: Inventory-Only Sync
docs.text:
❌ Create Missing Products: Disabled
✅ Stock Quantity: Enabled
✅ Low Stock: Enabled
❌ Other Fields: Disabled

Why? Only sync stock levels, leave other data unchanged.

docs.title: SKU Matching
docs.text:
Products are matched between Zoho and WooCommerce using SKU as the unique identifier.

Important

SKUs must match exactly (case-sensitive). Mismatched SKUs will result in duplicate products if "Create Missing Products" is enabled.

docs.title: What Doesn't Get Synced?
docs.text:
The following are not currently synced from Zoho to WooCommerce:

  • ❌ Product categories/tags
  • ❌ Custom fields (unless mapped)
  • ❌ Product reviews
  • ❌ Sales data
  • ❌ Purchase price (cost of goods)
  • ❌ Supplier information

Note

LZ SKU Sync is one-way from Zoho to WooCommerce. Changes in WooCommerce are not sent back to Zoho.

docs.title: Saving Your Preferences
docs.text:
After configuring all settings:

  1. Scroll to the bottom of the Sync Preferences section
  2. Click Save Preferences
  3. You'll see a success message
  4. Settings are now active for all future syncs

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text:
Once you've configured your sync preferences:

  • Learn About Image Management → - Understand how images are handled
  • Monitor Sync Progress → - Track what's happening

docs.title: Changes Not Taking Effect
docs.text:
Problem: Settings don't seem to apply

Solution:

  • Ensure you clicked "Save Preferences"
  • Refresh the page to verify settings were saved
  • For webhooks, changes apply to new events only (not retroactive)

docs.title: Too Many Products Created
docs.text:
Problem: Duplicate or unwanted products appearing

Solution:

  • Disable "Create Missing Products"
  • Check SKU matching in Zoho vs WooCommerce
  • Run manual sync after fixing SKUs to update existing products

docs.title: Images Not Syncing
docs.text:
Problem: Product Image/Gallery Image enabled but images missing

Solution:

  • Verify products have images in Zoho Inventory
  • Check Sync Log for errors
  • See Image Management for detailed troubleshooting

docs.title: Synchronization Methods
docs.text: LZ SKU Sync offers two ways to sync your products: Manual Sync and Real-Time Webhooks.

docs.title: Choose Your Sync Method
docs.text: Feature Manual Sync Webhook Sync Trigger Click "Start Sync" button Automatic when Zoho changes Timing On-demand Real-time (within seconds) Best For Initial setup, bulk updates Ongoing operations

docs.title: Manual Sync
docs.text: Best for initial setup, periodic bulk updates, or when you prefer full control.

docs.title: Start a Manual Sync
docs.text:
1. Go to LZ SKU Sync > Sync Status
  2. Configure your sync preferences
  3. Click Start Sync
  4. Monitor real-time progress
  5. Review synced items as they complete

docs.title: Sync Controls
docs.text:
• ⏸️ Pause - Temporarily stop sync (can resume later)
  • ▶️ Resume - Continue a paused sync
  • ❌ Cancel - Stop sync permanently (cannot resume)

docs.title: Progress Display
docs.text:
During sync, you'll see:

  • Total Products - Number of products queued
  • Synced - Successfully processed
  • Failed - Products with errors
  • Pending - Waiting in queue
  • Progress Bar - Visual completion status

Tip

Sync continues in the background even if you close your browser.

docs.title: Real-Time Webhook Sync
docs.text: Best for ongoing operations where Zoho Inventory is your primary product management system.

docs.title: Enable Webhooks
docs.text:
1. Go to LZ SKU Sync > Sync Status
  2. Find Sync Frequency setting
  3. Select "Always (Real-time webhook)"
  4. Click Save Preferences

The plugin automatically configures everything in Zoho Inventory!

docs.title: Webhook Status
docs.text:
• 🟢 Active (Green) - Receiving updates
  • 🔴 Inactive (Red) - Paused

Click the status indicator to toggle on/off.

Tip

See Webhook Integration for detailed webhook setup and troubleshooting.

docs.title: Recommended Approach
docs.text:
1. Initial Setup: Run a manual sync to import all products
  2. Ongoing: Enable webhook sync for real-time updates
  3. Periodic: Run manual sync occasionally to verify consistency

docs.title: What Gets Synchronized?
docs.text:
Based on your Product Settings:

  • ✅ Product name and description
  • ✅ SKU and price
  • ✅ Stock quantity and status
  • ✅ Low stock threshold
  • ✅ Weight and dimensions
  • ✅ Product images
  • ✅ Product variations and attributes

  • Contact support if issue persists

  • Verify license is active

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text: Solutions to common issues you may encounter with LZ SKU Sync.

docs.title: 1. Authentication Errors
docs.text:
Symptoms:

  • "Invalid authentication" or "Token expired" errors
  • "Failed to connect to Zoho"
  • API calls failing

Solutions:

A. Auto-Refresh

  • Tokens auto-refresh every 58 minutes
  • Wait a few minutes and try again

B. Reconnect

  1. Go to LZ SKU Sync > Settings > Authentication
  2. Click Disconnect
  3. Click Connect with Zoho again
  4. Re-authorize the connection

C. Verify Organization Access

  • Ensure you still have access to the organization in Zoho
  • Check that Zoho Inventory is active
  • Verify you have admin permissions

D. Check API Rate Limits

  • Zoho limits: 100 requests per minute
  • Plugin respects limits automatically
  • If exceeded, sync will pause and retry

docs.title: 2. Images Not Downloading
docs.text:
Symptoms:

  • Products sync successfully
  • Images missing from product pages
  • No featured image set

Solutions:

A. Verify Images in Zoho

  1. Log into Zoho Inventory
  2. Go to Items > [Product Name]
  3. Check "Attachments" tab
  4. Ensure images are uploaded

B. Check Image Sync Settings

  1. Go to LZ SKU Sync > Sync Status
  2. Verify "Product Image" is enabled
  3. Verify "Gallery Images" is enabled (if wanted)
  4. Save preferences and re-sync

C. Check PHP ZIP Extension

Contact your hosting provider to ensure the PHP ZIP extension is installed and enabled.

D. Verify Upload Directory

Check that your WordPress uploads directory is writable. Contact your hosting provider if you need assistance.

E. Review Sync Log

  1. Go to LZ SKU Sync > Sync Log (see Sync Log Guide)
  2. Check for failed image download actions
  3. Review error messages

F. Check API Rate Limits

  • Images are rate-limited (2 seconds between requests)
  • For 100 products with images: ~3-5 minutes minimum
  • This is normal - be patient!

docs.title: 3. Webhooks Not Receiving
docs.text:
Symptoms:

  • Changes in Zoho don't appear in WooCommerce
  • Webhook status shows inactive
  • No recent items in sync log

Solutions:

A. Verify Webhook Settings

  1. Sync Frequency: Set to "Always (Real-time webhook)"
  2. Status Indicator: Should be green (active)
  3. License: Must be active

B. Check Webhook Logs in Zoho

  1. Log into Zoho Inventory
  2. Go to Settings > Webhooks
  3. Find LZ SKU Sync webhook
  4. Check delivery logs for errors

C. Enable Debug Mode

Enable WordPress debug mode (contact your developer or hosting provider for assistance) to capture any errors in the debug log.

D. Verify License

  • Ensure license is active (not expired)
  • Check at LZ SKU Sync > Settings

docs.title: 4. Variations Not Creating
docs.text:
Symptoms:

  • Variable products sync
  • Variations missing from WooCommerce
  • Only parent product created

Solutions:

A. Enable Variation Creation

  1. Go to LZ SKU Sync > Sync Status
  2. Enable "Create Missing Variations"
  3. Save preferences
  4. Re-sync the product

B. Verify SKUs in Zoho

  • Each variation must have a unique SKU
  • Check in Zoho Inventory > Items > Product Group
  • Ensure all variants have SKU assigned

C. Check Attribute Fields

  • Zoho must have attribute names defined for variations
  • These fields define WooCommerce attributes

D. Review Sync Log

  1. Go to LZ SKU Sync > Sync Log (see Sync Log Guide)
  2. Check for failed variation actions
  3. Review error messages

docs.title: 5. Duplicate Products Created
docs.text:
Symptoms:

  • Multiple products with same name
  • SKUs don't match
  • Products created instead of updated

Solutions:

A. Fix SKU Matching

  • SKUs must match exactly (case-sensitive)
  • Check Zoho SKU vs WooCommerce SKU
  • Fix typos, extra spaces, or case differences

B. Disable Product Creation

If you only want updates, not new products:

  1. Disable "Create Missing Products"
  2. Disable "Create Missing Variations"
  3. Save preferences

C. Delete Duplicates

  1. Go to Products in WooCommerce
  2. Find duplicate products
  3. Delete the incorrect ones
  4. Re-sync with correct SKU matching

docs.title: 6. Stock Quantities Incorrect
docs.text:
Symptoms:

  • WooCommerce stock doesn't match Zoho
  • Always showing 0 stock
  • Stock not updating

Solutions:

A. Verify Warehouse Selection

  1. Go to LZ SKU Sync > Sync Status
  2. Check Sync Warehouse setting
  3. Ensure correct warehouse is selected
  4. Save and re-sync

B. Enable Stock Quantity Sync

  1. Check "Available Stock Quantity" is enabled in field settings
  2. Save preferences
  3. Run manual sync

C. Check Item Status in Zoho

  • Ensure item is "Active" (not archived)
  • Verify item is assigned to selected warehouse
  • Check actual stock in Zoho matches expectations

docs.title: 7. License Activation Failures
docs.text:
Symptoms:

  • "Invalid license key" error
  • "Order ID not found" error
  • Activation fails

Solutions:

A. Verify License Details

  • Order ID: From your purchase confirmation
  • License Key: Check for typos, extra spaces
  • Order Status: Must be "Processing" or "Completed"

B. Check Order at LinkZoho

  1. Log into app.linkzoho.com
  2. Go to Orders
  3. Verify order status
  4. Copy license key directly (don't retype)

C. Site Activation Limit

  • Each license has activation limit
  • Check if you've exceeded allowed sites
  • Deactivate from old sites if needed
  • Contact support to increase limit

D. Contact Support If issue persists:

  • 📧 Email: sales@linkzoho.com, support@krenovate.com
  • Include Order ID (not license key)
  • Include error message screenshot

docs.title: Debug Mode
docs.text:
If you need detailed logging for troubleshooting, contact your developer or hosting provider to enable WordPress debug logging. This will capture:

  • Error messages
  • Processing logs
  • Token refresh attempts
  • Error details

The debug log can be found at wp-content/debug.log on your server.

docs.title: Server Requirements
docs.text: Ensure your server meets these requirements:

docs.title: Minimum Requirements
docs.text:
• PHP Version: 7.4 or higher (8.0+ recommended)
  • WordPress: 4.7 or higher
  • WooCommerce: 7.9 or higher
  • MySQL: 5.6 or higher

docs.title: Recommended PHP Settings
docs.text:
• Memory Limit: 256MB or higher
  • Max Execution Time: 300 seconds or higher

If you're unsure about your server configuration, contact your hosting provider.

docs.title: Q: Can I sync from WooCommerce to Zoho?
docs.text: A: No, this is a one-way sync from Zoho to WooCommerce only.

docs.title: Q: Can I sync from multiple warehouses?
docs.text: A: Only one warehouse at a time. You can switch warehouses in settings.

docs.title: Q: Will existing products be overwritten?
docs.text: A: Only if SKU matches. Enabled fields will be updated, others unchanged.

docs.title: Q: How do I stop creating new products?
docs.text: A: Disable "Create Missing Products" in sync preferences.

docs.title: Q: Can I sync just inventory, no other changes?
docs.text: A: Yes! Enable only "Stock Quantity" in field settings, disable all others.

docs.title: Q: Why are images taking so long?
docs.text: A: Rate limiting (2 seconds per product) prevents API throttling. This is intentional.

docs.title: Q: Can I run syncs via cron or WP-CLI?
docs.text: A: Manual syncs are UI-triggered. Use webhook mode for automation.

docs.title: Q: Does it support product categories?
docs.text: A: Not currently. Only product data, attributes, and inventory.

docs.title: Before Contacting Support
docs.text:
1. ✅ Check this troubleshooting guide
  2. ✅ Review Sync Log for errors
  3. ✅ Verify authentication is connected

docs.title: Contacting Support
docs.text:
Email: sales@linkzoho.com, support@krenovate.com

Include:

  • WordPress version
  • PHP version
  • WooCommerce version
  • Plugin version
  • Clear description of issue
  • Screenshots of error messages
  • Relevant log excerpts (from Sync Log)
  • Steps to reproduce

Don't Include:

  • License key (only Order ID if needed)
  • API credentials
  • Full database dumps

docs.title: Webhook Integration
docs.text: Set up real-time automatic synchronization from Zoho Inventory to WooCommerce.

docs.title: What Are Webhooks?
docs.text: Webhooks enable real-time, automatic synchronization. When you create or update an item in Zoho, the change appears in your store within seconds—no manual sync required.

docs.title: Enable Webhooks
docs.text:
1. Go to LZ SKU Sync > Sync Status
  2. Find Sync Frequency setting
  3. Select "Always (Real-time webhook)"
  4. Click Save Preferences

The plugin automatically configures everything in Zoho Inventory - no manual setup needed!

docs.title: Status Indicator
docs.text:
Visual indicator shows webhook status:

  • 🟢 Active (Green): Receiving and processing updates
  • 🔴 Inactive (Red): Webhooks paused

docs.title: Toggle Webhook
docs.text:
To pause or resume webhooks:

  1. Click the webhook status indicator
  2. Status toggles between active/inactive
  3. Configuration is preserved when paused

Active: Products update in real-time when changed in Zoho

Inactive: Changes in Zoho are ignored until reactivated

docs.title: Recently Synced Items
docs.text: Webhook-triggered syncs appear in the "Recently Synced Items" table at LZ SKU Sync > Sync Status.

docs.title: Webhook Sync Log
docs.text: 30-day history of webhook events at LZ SKU Sync > Sync Status > Webhook Sync Log.

docs.title: Initial Setup
docs.text:
1. ✅ Run manual sync first to import all products
  2. ✅ Verify products synced correctly
  3. ✅ Enable webhook sync for ongoing updates

docs.title: Temporary Pause
docs.text:
To pause without losing configuration:

  • Toggle webhook to inactive
  • Make bulk changes in Zoho
  • Toggle back to active
  • Run manual sync to catch changes made while inactive

docs.title: Webhooks Not Working
docs.text:
Solutions:

  1. ✅ Check sync frequency is "Always (Real-time webhook)"
  2. ✅ Check webhook status indicator is green (active)
  3. ✅ Verify license is active
  4. ✅ Check Zoho Inventory > Settings > Webhooks for errors
  5. ✅ Contact support if issue persists

docs.title: Delayed Updates
docs.text:
Solutions:

  • Check LZ SKU Sync > Sync Log for queue status
  • Contact your hosting provider about server performance

docs.title: Duplicate Products
docs.text:
Solutions:

  • Verify SKUs match exactly (case-sensitive) between Zoho and WooCommerce
  • Check "Create Missing Products" setting
